# Publishable workspace crates, in dependency (topological) order.
#
# Source of truth for release crate order:
#   .github/workflows/.crates.yml - exposes the crate list to release jobs
#   .github/workflows/release.yml - publishes crates sequentially via soltiHQ/actions/cargo-publish
#
# Dependency layout - required + optional (because publish runs with `--all-features`):
#   solti-model       - no internal deps
#   solti-tls         - no internal deps
#   solti-observe     - optional: solti-model
#   solti-runner      - solti-model
#   solti-exec        - solti-model, solti-runner
#   solti-core        - solti-model, solti-runner
#   solti-api         - solti-model, solti-core; optional: solti-tls (`tls` feature)
#   solti-discover    - solti-model, solti-core; optional: solti-tls (`tls` feature)
#   solti-prometheus  - solti-runner; optional: solti-model, solti-core, solti-api, solti-discover
#
# When adding a publishable crate, insert it at its correct topological position.
# Dry-run / docs matrix consumers don't care about order, but release.yml publishes sequentially and depends on it.

solti-model
solti-tls
solti-observe
solti-runner
solti-exec
solti-core
solti-api
solti-discover
solti-prometheus
